title: Correction Remediation Apply Gates
principle: Remediation execution must be explicit, owner-scoped, auditable and reversible. Public UI can request an apply gate only after a protected backend plan exists, and it must never mutate private source data directly.
public_repo_rule: GitHub Pages stores only remediation gate metadata and the latest application receipt. Raw prompts, raw responses, transcripts, provider keys, session tokens and document text remain outside public storage.

backend_route.purpose: Record confirmed remediation step applications and apply correction undo follow-through without allowing public frontend source mutations.

safe_outcomes: Recorded manual review target for memory scope remediation
Recorded manual review target for knowledge source remediation
Recorded knowledge collection split proposal without changing documents
Applied correction undo follow-through against the correction trail only

scenarios.expected: Every draft remediation step exposes an Apply gate control after plan creation.
Apply gate calls the protected backend route with correction_id, step_id and confirm:true only.
Non-undo remediation applications are rendered as recorded receipts with rollback hints and manual targets.
Prepare-undo steps can mark the correction trail as undone while source data remains protected.

next.label: Memory and knowledge remediation adapters
next.reason: Apply gates now record confirmed intent. The next slice should connect those records to protected memory and knowledge adapters that can prepare exact source-scope updates behind backend policy.
